description: Get the Himalayas page where the user practises interviewing for a specific job: a Himalayas job (company_slug and job_slug) or a job elsewhere (application_link). On that page the user has a live spoken mock interview with an AI interviewer playing the company's hiring manager, with questions built from the job and their profile, then gets a score out of 100 with what went well and what to improve (sessions of 90 seconds or more are scored). Sessions and scores are saved to the account, so the user can see how they improve over time (list_interviews, get_interview_results). Free accounts include one text mock interview; spoken interviews are part of Himalayas Plus (30 minutes a month). Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

application_link.description: https link to a job posted somewhere else

company_slug.description: Company slug of a Himalayas job

job_slug.description: Job slug of a Himalayas job
